name: Alt Text Generator- Automatically generate alt text for images using AI
author: Bryam Loaiza

sections.description:
Alt Text Generator automatically generates descriptive alt text for images using AI to help you rank faster on Google.

Rank faster on search engines with SEO optimized alt text descriptions and increase visibility.

Get a free API key at Alt Text Generator Dashboard to start generating alt text today!

Features

Automatic: Alt text is automatically added to every image uploaded on the site.

Customizable: Manually update and edit the AI generated alt text. You can also click on the Generate Alt Text button to generate alt text for each image.

Easy to Set Up: Just choose a plan from our pricing page and start generating alt text for free.

Free Credits: Get 2 free credits upon sign up.

Extensive Image Support: Supports the following image types: JPEG, JPG, PNG, SVG, GIF, and WEBP.

Extensive Language Support: Supports the following languages: English, Arabic, Bulgarian, Chinese, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese.

WooCommerce Integration: Built-in WooCommerce integration.

sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for Alt Text Generator by Bryam Loaiza
  3. Install and Activate the plugin from your plugins page.
  4. Visit https://alttextgeneratorai.com/dashboard to get a free API key.
  5. Copy your API key into the Alt Text Generator plugin settings page on the side bar.
  6. Done! Upload an image to have alt text generated automatically using AI.
sections.faq:
What is alt text?

Alt text, or alternative text, is a brief description that makes your images accessible to visually impaired users and improves SEO.

What does alt mean in text?

Alt stands for ‘alternative’ and refers to the descriptive text displayed when an image fails to load. It’s essential for accessibility and SEO.

Why does alt text matter for SEO?

Alt text is essential for SEO as it helps search engines understand image content and improve accessibility to rank faster.

Does the plugin have an automatic and bulk feature for alt text generation?

Yes, our plugin generates alt text automatically upon image upload and can generate alt text in bulk as well.

Is alt text generated in multiple languages?

Yes, our plugin supports 35+ languages.

Can I customize the alt text?

Yes, you can edit the generated alt text.

How can I get started?

You can follow our WordPress tutorial here
